notes: 'secretly' is taken as part of the Pual verb's own rendering rather than an added adverb, corroborated by the ASV's margin ('brought by stealth').

Head of s005 is placed on 'brought' as the lexical predicate (rule 24); the competing reading heads it on 'secretly', which carries the stealth of גָּנַב under rule 44's complement test, and is defensible.
s011+s012 מִמֶּנְהוּ → 'thereof' is one fused preposition-plus-suffix unit headed on the preposition, no relative standing (rules 30, 22).
